internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:07 UTC on November 8, 2026, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate (12%) detected in the cart service. Initial diagnosis confirmed the error injection originated within the cart service itself, with no abnormal error rates or latencies observed in dependent services. 

Actions taken included disabling the 'cartFailure' flag at 12:27 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-action monitoring verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels (approximately 0.2%).

The incident was resolved without impact on other services. Further investigation into recent deployments is ongoing to rule out any contributing factors.

Severity: SEV2
